nodes.text: You've done the queen's errand and walked the Marshal's line. One more, and it's the heaviest. The high passes are turning bold — trolls off the scree, worgs on the shepherds' shoulders. The Line holds because someone does the work. This season, I'm asking you.
After, you present yourself to the Castellan. Maren weighs who the Crown may trust, and she doesn't take my word for it. That's why her word is worth having.
Two trolls, four worgs, and the shepherds sleep again. Then the Castellan. Then me. Go steady.
The mountain keeps. So does the offer.
